title: Healthy Habits
text:
Anna wants to be healthy. Every morning, she drinks a glass of water. She eats fruit and vegetables at lunch. She goes for a walk after school.

Anna also sleeps for nine hours every night. She turns off her phone before bed. Her mother says she has more energy now. Anna is happy with her healthy habits.

questions.text: What does Anna drink every morning?
How many hours does Anna sleep every night?
Why is Anna probably feeling better now?
options: She follows healthy habits every day

questions.text: Why does Anna turn off her phone before bed?
options: She wants to call her mother

paragraph_translations: Anna sağlıklı olmak istiyor. Her sabah bir bardak su içiyor. Öğle yemeğinde meyve ve sebze yiyor. Okuldan sonra yürüyüşe çıkıyor.
Anna ayrıca her gece dokuz saat uyuyor. Yatmadan önce telefonunu kapatıyor. Annesi artık daha fazla enerjisi olduğunu söylüyor. Anna sağlıklı alışkanlıklarından memnun.
